hashes.record: SHA256(canonical_bytes({binding_profile:new period profile,binding_spec_sha256:new period spec hash,source_ref,record})); binds validity, revises and quantity content hash; old reviews never translated
hashes.source: SHA256(canonical_bytes(source with slots/records/reviews sorted by id and quantities by ref)); nested arrays remain unchanged; preserve original source separately

selection: V=visible slot records; E=confirmed with visible content-matching human review; C=E covering target_at in bounded [start,end); D=all direct revises targets of C even when reviser is masked; A=C-D; no whole-record supersession, latest-wins, equal-value merging or transitive removal through pending records
gates: unknown capabilities on every visible record and referenced quantity in queried slot, including pending/masked/out-of-period
unknown or unspecified validity of any eligible record
unknown property/specimen/method/kind/unit on the unique selected record
context: explicit period quantity domain applies at every instant of stated interval; no instant-to-period, aggregate-to-period, persistence or clinical inference; interval-valued domains impose no temporal correlation; compare unsupported
variables: one local operand per selected record version for each conversion; preserve original IDs and mapping; no cross-time variable identity claim
confirmation: new profile and native hash bind complete record including validity and revises and quantity content; human flag structural only; no synthesized reviews, clinical claims or certification
steps: 1 + N_slots + N_quantities + sum_view(N_records + N_reviews + sum_query(2 + N_visible_in_slot + N_eligible_revises_edges_in_slot + 8)); prepay full row; child once at budget 8 only on numerically eligible row; no refunds; target_at does not change charge
answers: computed only publishes values, binding_evidence and calculation_evidence; all other rows null these; completed semantic diagnostics allowed; unfinished diagnostics null and assessment_complete=false; incomplete lists only unfinished rows
scope: convert only; explicitly asserted finite periods; no G/E import, synthetic instant/review, compare, display, time correlation, unknown validity refinement, retraction, persistent store, FHIR or billing export

validity.revision: same slot, strictly later record, bounded reviser contained in each target; unknown validity refinement unsupported
